name: stage4_predictions
notes: Predictions for the Stage 4 discriminating experiments, written before launching them; H-A model sigma = minSF x 39/K with K(straight)=1.25, K(necked)=1.8.

predictions.name: S4_square_D40
predictions.rationale: H-A vs H-B pair 1/2: coarse square pores (straight uniform ligaments), reference of the pair

predictions.name: S4_circle_D40_sameMinSF
predictions.rationale: pair 1: circular pores with diameter = square side (17.6 A) -> same minSF (0.52) but lower porosity (0.16); H-A predicts weaker than square (necked paths), H-B predicts >= square

predictions.name: S4_circle_D40_samePhi
predictions.rationale: pair 2: circular pores at the same porosity (0.20) -> minSF 0.45

predictions.name: S4_square_D40_dispersed

predicted.basis: weakest row ~10% below mean; H-C: multi-step; H-C': single avalanche

predictions.rationale: pair 3 (H-C): square coarse mesh with +-15% pore-size dispersion (non-equivalent rows) at the same porosity

predictions.name: S4_p32_dispersed
predictions.rationale: pair 4 (H-C): period-32 round-pore mesh with +-15% size dispersion

predictions.name: S4_precrack_L30_cell150
predictions.rationale: H-E: 30 A crack in a 150 A cell (image interaction removed)

predictions.name: S4_precrack_L40_cell150
predictions.rationale: H-E: 40 A crack in a 150 A cell (image interaction removed)

predictions.name: S4_H2_D40_W8_veins_x

predicted.basis: minSF=0.72; H-F: x-veins add straight load paths, y-veins add nothing (H-F' predicts xy > x)

predictions.rationale: H-F: two-level mesh with veins only along x (parallel to the load) at matched porosity; xy reference = S2_H2_D40_W8 (12.8 N/m)

predictions.name: S4_H2_D40_W8_veins_y

predicted.basis: minSF=0.73; H-F: x-veins add straight load paths, y-veins add nothing (H-F' predicts xy > x)

predictions.rationale: H-F: two-level mesh with veins only along y (perpendicular to the load) at matched porosity; xy reference = S2_H2_D40_W8 (12.8 N/m)
